issues.explanation: No new Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, violating test-first and the Livewire definition of done.
issues.location: change.diff (no new tests/*; only tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php import removal)

issues.explanation: Register uses inline validate array with no #[Validate] attributes, deviating from the #[Validate] plus $this->validate() project pattern.
Verification resend flashes literal verification-link-sent and the view renders it raw instead of a translated ui.* string.
Guest middleware guarding Livewire login/register is not persisted via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so update requests may bypass the guest-only boundary.
Password reset link and reset endpoints validate email with email instead of email:strict required for login/register.
NewPassword store validates three fields inline with $request->validate instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Diff includes cosmetic unrelated edits such as provider import restyling, trailing-newline fixes, and an unused-import removal.

conventions.evidence: Login uses #[Validate] plus $this->validate() (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:239) but Register has no #[Validate] attributes (app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:303-309); NewPasswordController validates 3 fields inline (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:162)

readability.evidence: Small focused classes and clear names, e.g. EmailVerificationPromptController::__invoke (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationPromptController.php:60) and LogoutController::__invoke (app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:121); no dead code

requirements.evidence: Login throttle/auth.failed/intended-home (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:252-272), Password::defaults min8+letters+mixedCase+numbers (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:391), remember_token rotation plus PasswordReset event (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:170-176), 403 on tampered id/hash (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:85-91); gaps: raw verification-link-sent status (resources/views/auth/verify-email.blade.php:644) and non-strict email on password endpoints

scope.evidence: Auth routes, controllers, Livewire components, layout and ui lang files all serve the task; only noise is bootstrap/providers.php import restyle, lang trailing-newline fixes, and BulmaTest.php import removal

security.evidence: Strict email on login/register, RateLimiter on login/register plus throttle:6,1 on password/verification routes, session regenerate/invalidate plus CSRF rotation, {{ }} escaping, MustVerifyEmail with id/hash 403 checks; limited gaps: guest middleware persistence and non-strict email on reset endpoints

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::sendResetLink (app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:213), Password::reset (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:168), Password::defaults once, and redirect()->route() throughout; no new abstractions

tests.evidence: No new tests ship with the change; the only test edit removes an unused import in tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:885, with no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests

review.summary: Implements the full session auth flow with correct routes, Livewire pages, throttling, session handling and pt_BR localization. Missing tests and the Register #[Validate] deviation plus an untranslated verification status require changes before merging.
